newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aristocrat shares plunge on reinstatement.
newsitem.headline: Aristocrat shares plunge on reinstatement.

text.p: Shares in gaming machine operator Aristocrat Leisure Ltd tumbled at the opening on Thursday after being reinstated to trading.

In early trading, the stock was 37 cents or nearly 13 percent lower at A$2.50. Aristocrat's shares were suspended on July 23 after it released only some details of a notice by the Colorado Limited Gaming Control Commission denying it the renewal of its licence to operate in the U.S. state.
Aristocrat said it would not release the full notice because it said some of the information in it was incorrect and that a number of allegations were defamatory.
Volumes were light. "It all of the back of the Colorado licence," said one Sydney-based broker.
"I think people are going to keep away from this stock until this (Colorado) issue blows over," he said.
